title: Peptide Charge Modulates Ion Binding to EF-Hand Motifs: A Molecular Dynamics Study
authors: Bailey Hanson; Diana Lambropoulos; Madelyn Smith; Jian Hu; Pengfei Li
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过MD模拟探讨EF-hand肽段电荷对镧系离子结合的影响，虽涉及蛋白-离子互作，但对象为金属离子而非DNA，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Rare earth elements (REEs), particularly lanthanides (Ln), are of significant interest due to their critical roles in modern technology and medicine. However, their extraction, isolation, and purification remain challenging. Lanmodulin (LanM), a recently discovered EF-hand protein, exhibits high affinity and selectivity for binding Ln3+ ions. This enhanced affinity is partly attributed to the presence of additional acidic residues within its EF-hand metal binding loops. Previous studies have demonstrated that reducing the number of ligating acidic residues within EF-hand motifs significantly decreases their binding affinities for La3+. Yet, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. To address this, we performed molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and MMPBSA/MMGBSA analyses on a series of EF-hand motifs with varying numbers of ligating acidic residues. Our results reveal that the number of acidic ligands strongly influences the structure of the peptide–ion complex. Specifically, a decrease in ligating acidic residue leads to increased coordination of water molecules to La3+. We also observed a complex interplay among different ligand types, including ligating acidic and neutral residues, non-ligating acidic residues, backbone carbonyls, and water molecules. Notably, reducing the number of acidic ligands significantly alters the secondary structure of the EF-hand motif, increases its flexibility, and reshapes its free energy landscape. This study provides important molecular insights into how peptide charge modulates ion binding to EF-hand motifs, offering valuable guidance for the rational design of EF-hand proteins with tailored ion-binding properties.
abstract_zh: 稀土元素（REEs），特别是镧系元素（Ln），因其在现代技术和医学中的关键作用而备受关注。然而，其提取、分离和纯化仍具挑战性。Lanmodulin（LanM）是一种新发现的EF-hand蛋白，对结合Ln3+离子表现出高亲和力和选择性。这种增强的亲和力部分归因于其EF-hand金属结合环内额外的酸性残基的存在。先前研究表明，减少EF-hand基序中配位酸性残基的数量会显著降低其对La3+的结合亲和力。然而，其潜在分子机制仍知之甚少。为解决此问题，我们对一系列具有不同数量配位酸性残基的EF-hand基序进行了分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和MMPBSA/MMGBSA分析。我们的结果表明，酸性配体的数量强烈影响肽-离子复合物的结构。具体而言，配位酸性残基的减少导致水分子对La3+的配位增加。我们还观察到不同配体类型之间的复杂相互作用，包括配位酸性和中性残基、非配位酸性残基、主链羰基以及水分子。值得注意的是，减少酸性配体的数量显著改变了EF-hand基序的二级结构，增加了其灵活性，并重塑了其自由能景观。本研究提供了关于肽电荷如何调节离子与EF-hand基序结合的重要分子见解，为合理设计具有定制离子结合特性的EF-hand蛋白提供了宝贵指导。
